usd_reason: The dollar logged its worst week in over 3 months amid Fed doubts
gold_reason: Gold holds modest gain after Federal Reserve keeps rates steady
indices_reason: Treasury yields inch lower as investors await fresh economic data
lead_story: The US dollar has weakened after the Federal Reserve decided to hold interest rates steady, sparking doubts about the Fed's ability to tackle inflation. This decision has led to a decline in the dollar's value, with the dollar logging its worst week in over 3 months. As a result, investors are now awaiting fresh economic data to determine their next move.
